profile.headline: Operation Leader | Bridging Data, Automation & Business Strategy | SQL & Snowflake-Driven Process Optimization
profile.summary:
I'm an operations leader who's spent the last seven-plus years sitting at the intersection of technology, data, and people, first leading frontline teams at AT&T and Discover Financial Services, and now working as a Software Engineer at Capital One, where I help translate business needs into technical solutions. What ties that path together is a consistent instinct: find where a process is creating friction, dig into the data behind it, and build something better. 

At Capital One, that's meant partnering with business and technical stakeholders to automate a recurring manual process, cutting more than 10 hours of work per week, and working alongside Product and Engineering teams to translate requirements, surface risk, and validate solutions through QA testing before they ever reach customers. Earlier in my career, leading call center teams at Discover and AT&T taught me how to read performance data, coach to it, and turn recurring workflow problems into redesigned processes that stuck. I use SQL, Snowflake, and Tableau daily to make sure decisions are grounded in what the data actually shows, not just what feels right. 

I'm now looking to bring that same combination, technical fluency, cross-functional collaboration, and a bias toward measurable improvement, into a Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, or Program Management role in tech or fintech. If you're building a team that needs someone who can move comfortably between a data table and a stakeholder meeting, I'd love to connect. Feel free to reach out at breshelwilson@yahoo.com or right here on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Partner with Product and Engineering to translate business requirements into technical solutions, identify risks, and drive initiatives
through the full development lifecycle; track and resolve defects in Jira ahead of implementation.
•Administer SQL and Snowflake reporting environments supporting call center operations, strengthening data-integrity controls across
reporting layers and reducing operational risk by 15%.
•Automated a recurring operational process using SQL and Snowflake, eliminating 10+ hours of manual work weekly through
requirements analysis, solution development, and hands-on QA validation.
•Reengineer end-to-end workflows with operations leaders using Agile methodologies, converting frontline pain points into sprint-
ready solutions that reduce resolution times by 20% and improve first-contact resolution by 18%.
•Analyze customer feedback, survey data, call transcripts, and escalation trends to recommend system and process enhancements,
contributing to 12% gains in NPS and CSAT and informing future platform improvements.
•Conduct detailed code and SQL reviews to validate automation logic and edge-case handling, identifying downstream issues before
deployment and reducing production defect rework by 22%.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Data Analytics · Snowflake · Cross-functional Team Collaboration · Agile Methodologies · Business Process Improvement · Customer Experience Management · Tableau · Jira · Documentation & Requirements Gathering · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Problem Solving · Testing & Quality Assurance (QA) · SAS (Software) · Communication · Microsoft Suites · Debugging & Error Handling · Software Infrastructure · Software Development · Project Management

positions.title: Retail Sales Associate
positions.description:
•Deliver personalized customer experiences in a high-volume retail environment, driving customer satisfaction and brand loyalty. 
•Support store operations through inventory management, order fulfillment, and compliance with operational procedures. 
•Collaborate with team members to achieve sales, service, and operational performance goals. 
•Resolve customer concerns and product inquiries while maintaining a positive customer experience. 
•Consistently adapt to changing business needs in a fast-paced environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Personalized Customer Engagement · Problem Solving in High-Volume Environments · Active Listening & Empathy · Product Knowledge Communication · Point of Sale (POS) System Operation · Retail · Time Management & Prioritization · Conflict Resolution · Operational Excellence · Customer Experience · Relationship Building · Team Collaboration · Post-Sales Support · Pre-Sales Support

positions.title: Operations Team Lead, Call Center
positions.description:
•Led a 20+ person call center team, monitoring performance, auditing customer interactions, and delivering targeted coaching and
development plans to strengthen service levels, quality, and customer satisfaction.
•Redesigned coaching and workflow processes by replacing generic feedback with targeted, call-specific coaching, increasing QA
scores by 12%, and customer satisfaction by 17%.
•Implemented cross-training and workforce scheduling strategies using Workday and Workforce Management, creating flexible
coverage models that reduced handle times by 15% and improved productivity.
•Analyzed performance trends and frontline feedback to identify workflow and process gaps, partnering with operations, compliance,and workforce planning teams to improve first-contact resolution and address complex customer escalations within regulatory requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Experience Management · Call Monitoring & Quality Assurance · Time Management and Prioritization · Business Process Improvement · Clear and Empathetic Communication · Call Center Metrics & KPIs (AHT, FCR, CSAT) · Problem-Solving and Decision-Making · Team Coaching & Mentorship · Conducting Performance Reviews · Adaptability and Multitasking · Leadership · Performance Management · Team Development · Conflict Resolution · Workforce Management · Operational Excellence · Development Coaching · Cross-functional Collaborations

positions.title: Operations Team Lead, Call Center
positions.description:
•Managed a team of 25+ call center representatives supporting thousands of customers weekly, refining escalation protocols that improved first-contact resolution by 22%.
•Introduced standardized performance frameworks across the center, replacing inconsistent evaluation methods with a unified scorecard that increased productivity by 15% while strengthening compliance with company policy.
•Coached and trained agents on service techniques, tailoring feedback to individual skill gaps and driving a 20% boost in NPS scores and client retention.
•Led weekly performance reviews with agents, digging into call recordings and metrics to identify coaching opportunities that closed skill gaps within the team faster than standard review cycles allowed.
•Led a call center team in a fast-paced retail environment, improving team performance and consistency in the customer and sales
experience by analyzing performance trends, delivering targeted coaching, and adjusting daily operations and staffing priorities to meet business goals.

positions.title: Retail Manager | Operations & Team Development
positions.description:
•  Managed daily and monthly inventory reporting, reducing inventory discrepancies by 20% through improved reconciliation processes and operational controls. 
 •  Leveraged data analysis to identify operational trends and improve store performance, contributing to a 10% reduction in shrink impact. 
 •  Led end-to-end hiring, onboarding, and training efforts, improving candidate quality and reducing time-to-fill positions by 30%. 
 •  Coached and developed team members to deliver exceptional customer experiences while achieving sales and operational goals. 
 •  Educated customers on products and pricing strategies, increasing conversion rates, customer satisfaction, and add-on sales. 
 •  Partnered with leadership to execute staffing, scheduling, and operational initiatives that supported overall store performance.
